# Kick Stats for Stream Deck - Marketplace Listing Copy

## Search line
Real-time Kick follower count, live viewer count, and milestone progress on your Stream Deck. No API key or login needed.

## Tagline
Your Kick numbers. On your deck. Always.

## Description
Kick Stats puts your most important creator numbers on your Stream Deck keys. Enter your channel username and stats start loading immediately. No API key, no Kick login, no configuration.

Followers, live viewer count, new follows today, milestone progress, and 7-day growth trend. Six display modes per key. Short press to cycle modes. Long press to switch metrics.

## Features
- Follower count, live viewers, new follows today, and 7-day trend
- Milestone mode: progress bar to your next target with a days-to-goal estimate
- Live mode: viewer count updates every 90 seconds while you stream, then switches back to followers when you go offline
- Trend mode: 14-point sparkline built from 30 days of stored history
- No API key and no login required: public channel data only
